attrs.citation: Claessen & Hughes, QuickCheck: A Lightweight Tool for Random Testing of Haskell Programs, ICFP 2000
hypotheses: the property is decidable on a generated case
attrs.note: The paper's own title carries the load-bearing word. This is the whole basis for R5.1 refusing `exhaustion` as the type of a 2,000-trial property run.
attrs.result: Property-based testing checks a property against cases drawn from a user-supplied generator. It is RANDOM testing, not enumeration.
